brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a routine service and filter replacement visit for my whole-home water filtration system.
facts: I have an existing whole-home reverse osmosis water treatment system.
The system is due for its annual service and filter changes.
preferences: I prefer an afternoon appointment slot.
I am prepared to pay standard service rates up to $500.
I prefer text message reminders for service arrivals.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, up to the not-to-exceed figure they quote

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, new installations on 2, billing on 3.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Automated Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling ClearWater Solutions. For service, press 1. For new installations, press 2. For billing, press 3.

script.label: Agent Greeting
script.text: ClearWater service scheduling, this is Marcus speaking. How can I help you today?

script.label: System Check
script.text: I can certainly help book that. What type of water treatment setup do you have at the property?

script.label: Address Request
script.text: Understood. May I have your name and the service address, please?

script.label: Contact Number Request
script.text: Thank you. And what is the best callback number for the technician?

script.label: Quote Pricing
script.text: Our comprehensive annual maintenance package for that system is exactly 430 dollars, which covers parts, labor, and sanitization.

script.label: Offer Window
script.text: We have a technician available in your area this Thursday between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM. Would that arrival window work for you?

script.label: Confirm Booking
script.text: Great, I have you locked in for this Thursday between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM.

script.label: Additional Assistance
script.text: You will receive a confirmation text shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

script.label: Closing
script.text: Thank you for calling ClearWater Solutions. Have a wonderful day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
